mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM tb_address_book a JOIN tb_school s ON s.id = a.school_id AND s.deleted = 0 JOIN tb_compus c ON c.id = a.compus_id AND c.school_id = s.id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN tb_build_category t ON t.id = a.build_category_id AND t.school_id = s.id AND t.compus_id = c.id AND t.deleted = 0 JOIN tb_building b ON b.id = a.building_id AND b.school_id = s.id AND b.compus_id = c.id AND b.build_category_id = t.id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id IN (#{pickupId}, #{receiveId}) AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.school_id = #{schoolId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order_address_snapshot (order_id, role, address_id, school_id, compus_id, build_category_id, building_id, address, public_address, source, captured_at) SELECT #{orderId}, #{role}, a.id, a.school_id, a.compus_id, a.build_category_id, a.building_id, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.school_name, c.compus_name, t.name, b.building_name, a.details), CONCAT_WS(' ', s.school_name, c.compus_name, t.name, b.building_name), 'SUBMIT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tb_address_book a JOIN tb_school s ON s.id = a.school_id JOIN tb_compus c ON c.id = a.compus_id JOIN tb_build_category t ON t.id = a.build_category_id JOIN tb_building b ON b.id = a.building_id WHERE a.id = #{addressId}
